scope: Private native selection namespaces under immutable application identities
invariant: Each full application identity has independent native selection ownership and events. Trusted services must explicitly select the application namespace.
required_evidence: Version-1 behavior and sources preserved before migration.
Independent namespace baseline fails on both hosts.
Other application activity does not change query, claim, clear, or conversion behavior.
Same-application conversion emits a real SelectionRequest with public atom values.
Full workspace/application identity separation and both native byte orders.
Explicit supervisor and compositor scope selection; application and broker refusal.
Debug and core-X native-server ASan/UBSan checks on both hosts.
Full M04 graphics, locked acceptance, and integration gates remain required.
limitations: Version 2 deliberately replaces global owned-selection error behavior with application-private state.
Asynchronous metadata beyond selection events remains unqualified.
Focused core-X sanitizer runs disable GLX and do not qualify graphics-provider cleanup.
